title: Letters manifest.json, format 1
description: What a .let file is, and the hash of each of its entries. The file is a zip whose first entry, mimetype, is stored uncompressed and reads application/vnd.letters.document+zip.

format.description: Rises only for a breaking change.

id.description: The document's identity, shared by every copy of it.

hashes.description: Entry name to the SHA-256 of its content, for every entry but mimetype and manifest.json.
